DOJO

Seishinkai Karate Federation — Obihiro Branch

[Obihiro City Karate Class — Seishinkai Obihiro Branch]
The Obihiro karate class began in earnest in April 2017 (Heisei 29).
The venue is the Tetsunan District Community Center.
The class focuses mainly on Kids and Junior classes. Parent-child participation and Senior Class members are also welcome.
While many dojos feel like an extension of school sports-club activities, we aim for karate as health and fitness training — practicing and learning together in a relaxed, club-like atmosphere.

Dojo / Branch Address / Venue Training Days
□ Obihiro City Karate Club Nishi 2-jo Minami 24-chome, Obihiro City (Tetsunan area) Saturday 18:30

● Training days: Saturday 18:45–20:00
090-6692-6573 (Kudo) — please call after 5:00 PM, as we work during the day.
